# llms.txt

## Workshop Identity
- Title: THE ARCHITECTURE OF SHARED MEANING: Aligning Human Minds and AI Intelligence Through the C.L.E.A.R.+ Protocol
- Runtime: 120 minutes
- Segment count: 8
- Environment: responsive standalone HTML deck plus synchronized Markdown/docs
- Primary outcome: participants transform vague intent into reliable, auditable instructions for humans and AI systems

## Core Model
C.L.E.A.R.+ = Context, Limits, Expected Output, Audience, Role/Process, +Iterate/Verify.
Failure diagnosis maps weak outputs to missing fields: vague content -> Context or Expected Output; unsafe or invented content -> Limits; wrong tone/depth -> Audience; poor reasoning path -> Role/Process; unstable quality -> missing Iterate/Verify.
Steering loop: Diagnose -> Isolate -> Constrain. Change one variable per iteration. Add explicit exclusions and pass-fail checks before trusting output.

## 120-Minute Runtime Map
- Segment 1 | 00:00-00:15 | 15 min | The Intent & Meaning Bottleneck: Assumption Gap, Mars Climate Orbiter case, Start Ritual.
- Segment 2 | 00:15-00:35 | 20 min | The Human Delegation Lab: Architect vs. Builder, Zero-Feedback vs. Calibrated Grounding.
- Segment 3 | 00:35-00:43 | 8 min | The Multi-Lens Experiment: Can we climb a tree? child, psychologist, risk officer, arborist, heavy-eared alien.
- Segment 4 | 00:43-00:50 | 7 min | The C.L.E.A.R.+ Universal Protocol: Context, Limits, Expected Output, Audience, Role/Process, +Iterate/Verify.
- Segment 5 | 00:50-01:00 | 10 min | Reset, Bio-Break & Purposeful Table Alignment: timer plus three coffee reflection prompts.
- Segment 6 | 01:00-01:25 | 25 min | The Executive Makeover Studio: triad refactoring, 12 scenario library, six-point peer rubric.
- Segment 7 | 01:25-01:50 | 25 min | The Live Iteration Crucible & Steering Protocol: Diagnose -> Isolate -> Constrain, zero-trust data governance.
- Segment 8 | 01:50-02:00 | 10 min | Synthesis, Leadership Commitments & The Peak-End Close: one-minute teach-back and desk reference rollout.

## Presenter Metadata Contract
index.html must contain exactly one #speaker-overlay outside main. It is hidden on initial load with display: none and aria-hidden="true". Pressing s or S toggles #speaker-overlay.open; Escape closes it. Key handling ignores input, textarea, select, and contenteditable targets. Each slide section must include complete data-speaker-time, data-speaker-say, data-speaker-do, data-speaker-ask, data-speaker-adapt, and data-speaker-ritual attributes.

## Shared Scenario Set
- Mars Climate Orbiter: assumption gap and verification failure.
- Architect vs. Builder: zero-feedback delegation compared with calibrated grounding.
- Can we climb a tree?: child, psychologist, risk officer, arborist, heavy-eared alien lenses.
- Executive Makeover Studio: board update, customer apology, hiring calibration, risk memo, product launch, budget tradeoff, incident review, policy rewrite, sales brief, research synthesis, vendor comparison, executive ghostwrite.
- Zero-trust data governance: no invented facts/citations/numbers, no confidential data in prompts, no claims without traceable evidence.

## Theoretical Foundations
Clark & Brennan: common ground, contribution, feedback, and repair. Chris Voss: calibrated questions and constraint-led negotiation. Nancy Duarte: contrast, audience movement, strong opening/closing moments. Vaswani et al.: attention and context sensitivity in transformer systems; prompt quality controls the usable context window.

## File Index
- index.html: public deck, responsive 16:9 slide viewport, keyboard navigation, singleton presenter overlay, slide metadata source of truth.
- script.md: full speaker transcript and facilitation runbook for all eight segments.
- README.md: syllabus, theory, delivery checklist, repository map.
- cheatsheet.html: participant desk reference for C.L.E.A.R.+, peer rubric, steering loop, and governance checks.
- docs/prompting-framework.md: detailed C.L.E.A.R.+ protocol and verification reference.
- docs/workshop-summary.md: compact facilitator operating summary.
